high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "finforall." The post is part of a series, as indicated by the number "3/10" at the top right corner, suggesting it is the third installment in a ten-part sequence. The content of the post discusses the role of companies like Tata Motors (formerly called TELCO) and TCS during India's pre-liberalization era. It highlights how these companies played a pivotal role in establishing supply chains for key industries that later contributed to India's economic growth after liberalization.
